name: camofox-browser
description:
Star


  

  
    
    


      
        jo-inc /

      camofox-browser  

    
      Stealth headless browser for AI agents — bypass Cloudflare, bot detection, and anti-scraping. Drop-in Puppeteer/Playwright replacement.
summary: camofox-browser 是一个为 AI 代理设计的隐形无头浏览器，可绕过 Cloudflare 和反爬虫检测，并作为 Puppeteer/Playwright 的直接替代品。它值得关注，因为能显著提升自动化任务的隐蔽性和成功率。

name: deer-flow
description:
Star


  

  
    
    


      
        bytedance /

      deer-flow  

    
      An open-source long-horizon SuperAgent harness that researches, codes, and creates. With the help of sandboxes, memories, tools, skill, subagents and message gateway, it handles different levels of tasks that could take minutes to hours.
summary: 字节跳动开源的“DeerFlow”是一个面向长时间跨度复杂任务的智能体框架，能自主研究、编码和创作，并通过沙箱、记忆、工具与子代理协同处理耗时数分钟至数小时的任务。它值得关注，因为其设计聚焦于真实世界中的长周期自动化，代表了多智能体系统在工程化落地上的前沿探索。

      Lightpanda: the headless browser designed for AI and automation
summary: Lightpanda 是一个专为 AI 和自动化设计的无头浏览器，用 Zig 语言编写，主打极低资源占用和高性能。它值得关注，因为相比传统浏览器，它能为 AI 代理和爬虫任务提供更轻量、更快速的执行环境。

name: ruflo
description:
Star


  

  
    
    


      
        ruvnet /

      ruflo  

    
      🌊 The original agent meta-harness. Deploy intelligent multi-player swarms, coordinate autonomous workflows, and build conversational AI systems. Features adaptive memory, self-learning intelligence, RAG integration, and native Claude Code / Codex / Hermes and many more Integrated
summary: ruflo 是一个基于 TypeScript 的智能体“元框架”，用于部署多智能体协作集群、协调自主工作流并构建对话式 AI 系统，内置自适应记忆、自学习能力、RAG 集成及对 Claude Code、Codex 等主流工具的深度支持。它因提供开箱即用的复杂多智能体编排能力而值得关注。
